body: As my carpool partner suddenly veers off onto an unfamiliar road, panic grips me like a vice. The engine roars loudly behind, but I can't bring myself to turn back. Instead, I focus intently on the mirrors, hoping for any sign of headlights or movement to signal they're still following me. My heart pounds in my chest, each beat echoing through the silence. Thoughts swirl furiously—what if they don’t see me? What if something goes wrong now? But even as fear clouds my judgment, I push down the urge to act rashly.
